messages:
maria_support: Customer ticket #4567 — reports structured output schema lost top-level "items" array after we rolled out redwood-models/v3-beta@2026-03-10. Parser returns 422, their job fails nightly. Request id rq_abc123.

liya_ml: Can you paste the exact request body and a sample response? Any prompt changes on their side?

maria_support: Nothing changed client-side. Repro curl:

```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-models/v3-beta@2026-03-10","input":"Generate order list","structured_output":{"schema":"{\"items\": [{\"id\":\"string\",\"qty\":\"integer\"}]}","mode":"json"}}'
```

maria_support: Response from API (customer):

```json
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
{"request_id":"rq_abc123","output":"{\"header\":\"ok\"}"}
```

maria_support: Our parsing layer expects top-level "items" key; the model is returning a truncated object without it -> downstream 422.

james_platform: I'm seeing matching signals in rollout logs — v3-beta emits more concise summaries unless we enforce a JSON instruction. Looks like output template probability dropped and model sometimes skips optional fields. Could be a fine-tuning objective change.

liya_ml: Running local repro now against the same model and prompt. Preliminary: with temperature 0.0 and forced system prompt 'Return valid JSON only' I still see missing array ~30% of runs. If I add explicit wrapper in prompt ("Respond exactly with {\"items\": ... }"), success goes to 98%.

sre_oncall: For immediate mitigation: pin affected customers to v2.9-stable and open rollback for hosted pool in region nyc. I'll start the rollback job and throttle v3-beta canaries.

deploy-bot: deploy: Rollback initiated for hosted-pool-nyc to redwood-models/v2.9-stable (job job_9876).

liya_ml: Long-term fix options: (a) model-side instruction tuning to bias for strict structured output, (b) enforcing post-generation wrapper/validator that retries with stronger constraints, (c) add structured_output strict flag to API to run a deterministic JSON-constrained decoding. I'll draft a PR for strict flag.

james_platform: Also adding regression tests to release pipeline: 200-schema-eval cases to catch 'items' missing. I'll own rollout gating.

maria_support: Customer asked for ETA and compensation. I've provisionally credited them 8 hours of compute and set expectation: rollback done within 20m, longer fix ETA ~6h for strict flag + tests. I'll follow up.

sre_oncall: Rollback completed; customers pinned. Monitoring logs for failures. If we still see issues after pin, open infra ticket.

liya_ml: PR for strict_structured_output created: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4521 — adds validation + retry loop (2 attempts). Can we aim to deploy to canary in 4h?

james_platform: Action items: maria (pin & customer comms), liya (PR & canary deploy), james (regression tests + gating). ETA consolidated 6h. :white_check_mark:

maria_support: Assigned and communicated. Customer will re-run nightly job and confirm. Thanks everyone. :pray:
